(() => {
    var _a;
    const table = document.querySelector("table");
    if (!table)
        return;
    const body = table.tBodies[0];
    const headerRow = (_a = table.tHead) === null || _a === void 0 ? void 0 : _a.rows[0];
    if (!body || !headerRow)
        return;
    const tableBody = body;
    const rows = Array.from(body.rows);
    const headers = Array.from(headerRow.cells);
    const pageSize = 10;
    let page = 1;
    let sortColumn = -1;
    let sortDirection = 0;
    function cellText(row, column) {
        var _a, _b, _c;
        return (_c = (_b = (_a = row.cells[column]) === null || _a === void 0 ? void 0 : _a.textContent) === null || _b === void 0 ? void 0 : _b.trim()) !== null && _c !== void 0 ? _c : "";
    }
    headers.forEach((_header, column) => {
        const counts = new Map();
        rows.forEach((row) => {
            var _a;
            const value = cellText(row, column).toLowerCase();
            if (value)
                counts.set(value, ((_a = counts.get(value)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0) + 1);
        });
        rows.forEach((row) => {
            var _a, _b;
            const value = cellText(row, column).toLowerCase();
            if (value && ((_a = counts.get(value)) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : 0) > 1) {
                (_b = row.cells[column]) === null || _b === void 0 ? void 0 : _b.classList.add("cssv-dup");
            }
        });
    });
    const pager = document.createElement("div");
    pager.className = "cssv-pager";
    table.after(pager);
    function sortedRows() {
        if (sortDirection === 0)
            return [...rows];
        return [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
            const aText = cellText(a, sortColumn);
            const bText = cellText(b, sortColumn);
            const aNumber = Number.parseFloat(aText);
            const bNumber = Number.parseFloat(bText);
            const numeric = !Number.isNaN(aNumber) &&
                !Number.isNaN(bNumber) &&
                Number.isFinite(Number(aText)) &&
                Number.isFinite(Number(bText));
            const comparison = numeric
                ? aNumber - bNumber
                : aText.localeCompare(bText, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: "base" });
            return comparison * sortDirection;
        });
    }
    function render() {
        const allRows = sortedRows();
        const pageCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(allRows.length / pageSize));
        page = Math.min(page, pageCount);
        tableBody.replaceChildren(...allRows.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize));
        pager.hidden = allRows.length <= pageSize;
        pager.replaceChildren();
        const info = document.createElement("span");
        info.textContent = `Page ${page} of ${pageCount} · ${allRows.length} rows`;
        const navigation = document.createElement("div");
        function addButton(label, targetPage, disabled, active = false) {
            const button = document.createElement("button");
            button.type = "button";
            button.textContent = label;
            button.disabled = disabled;
            if (active)
                button.className = "on";
            button.onclick = () => {
                page = targetPage;
                render();
            };
            navigation.appendChild(button);
        }
        addButton("Prev", page - 1, page === 1);
        for (let targetPage = 1; targetPage <= pageCount; targetPage++) {
            if (targetPage === 1 || targetPage === pageCount || Math.abs(targetPage - page) <= 1) {
                addButton(String(targetPage), targetPage, false, targetPage === page);
            }
            else if (Math.abs(targetPage - page) === 2) {
                const ellipsis = document.createElement("span");
                ellipsis.textContent = "…";
                navigation.appendChild(ellipsis);
            }
        }
        addButton("Next", page + 1, page === pageCount);
        pager.append(info, navigation);
    }
    headers.forEach((header, column) => {
        const sortIndicator = document.createElement("span");
        sortIndicator.className = "cssv-sort";
        sortIndicator.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const up = document.createElement("i");
        up.className = "up";
        up.textContent = "▲";
        const down = document.createElement("i");
        down.className = "down";
        down.textContent = "▼";
        sortIndicator.append(up, down);
        header.appendChild(sortIndicator);
        header.tabIndex = 0;
        header.setAttribute("aria-sort", "none");
        function sortByHeader() {
            if (sortColumn === column) {
                sortDirection = sortDirection === 1 ? -1 : sortDirection === -1 ? 0 : 1;
            }
            else {
                sortColumn = column;
                sortDirection = 1;
            }
            if (sortDirection === 0)
                sortColumn = -1;
            headers.forEach((item, index) => {
                item.setAttribute("aria-sort", index === sortColumn ? (sortDirection === 1 ? "ascending" : "descending") : "none");
            });
            page = 1;
            render();
        }
        header.addEventListener("click", sortByHeader);
        header.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                sortByHeader();
            }
        });
    });
    render();
})();
